mapper.sql: id, shop_id, biz_date, show_count, debit_cents, income, order_count, source_hash, calculated_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mt_promotion_period_metric_daily ( shop_id, biz_date, show_count, debit_cents, income, order_count, source_hash, calculated_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{shopId}, #{bizDate}, #{showCount}, #{debitCents}, #{income}, #{orderCount}, #{sourceHash}, #{calculatedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE show_count = VALUES(show_count), debit_cents = VALUES(debit_cents), income = VALUES(income), order_count = VALUES(order_count), source_hash = VALUES(source_hash), calculated_at = VALUES(calculated_at), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
